question: Select the synonym of **Defer.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Defer"** means to postpone or delay an action or decision to a later time. (स्थगित करना)

 

 
• **Example: **The board decided to defer the meeting until next week.

 

 

 
• **"Delay" **refers to making something happen at a later time than originally planned or expected. (विलंब)

 

 
• **Example: **The train was delayed due to technical difficulties.

 

 

 
• Hence, the word **'Defer' **is synonymous with **'Delay'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Decline **(अस्वीकार करना): To refuse or reject something politely.

 

 
• **Example:** She declined the invitation to the party due to prior commitments.

 

 

 
• **Reject **(नकार देना): To dismiss or refuse to accept something.

 

 
• **Example: **The company rejected his job application because he lacked experience.

 

 

 
• **Proceed** (आगे बढ़ना): To move forward with an action or continue as planned.

 

 
• **Example:** After the break, the meeting proceeded as scheduled.
